mechanism: Deutetrabenazine is metabolized by CYP2D6 and hydroxychloroquine may inhibit CYP2D6, potentially increasing deutetrabenazine exposure; additionally, both agents carry risk of QT prolongation and CNS effects.
action: Monitor ECG and QT interval; consider baseline and periodic cardiac monitoring; assess for increased deutetrabenazine side effects (sedation, parkinsonism, akathisia) and adjust dosing if needed.
